assessment_objectives.objective: the predetermined actions each Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) executes upon detection of a potentially hazardous event are documented in a Safety Requirements Specification (SRS).
the detection conditions (e.g., trip points) that initiate each Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) are defined and documented.

Safety Instrumented Functions (SIFs) within the Safety Instrumented System (SIS) automatically execute the predetermined actions when the defined detection conditions are met, without requiring operator intervention.
each Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) is functionally tested at the defined proof test interval to confirm it executes the predetermined actions and the results are documented.
bypasses or overrides of a Safety Instrumented Function (SIF) are authorized, time limited and logged.
